text: American Family Insurance is a mutual: its parent is American Family Mutual Insurance Company, S.I., owned by its policyholders rather than by external shareholders, with American Family Connect, Homesite and Main Street America operating under the same mutual umbrella. There is no state stake and no listed float. Human-rights relevance is indirect - a US property-and-casualty insurer with no extractive or state-linked exposure.
